text:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : n ^ 2 % 3 ∈ {0, 1} := by
    rw [mod_self]
    cases n % 3 with q r
    exact ⟨r, r rfl⟩
  have h2 : (n ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = 0 ↔ n ^ 2 % 3 = 2 :=
    by rw [mod_add_right, mod_eq_iff_div_eq, mod_eq_iff_div_eq, mod_eq_iff_div_eq, mod_eq_iff_div_eq]
  rw [h2] at h
  have h3 : n ^ 2 % 3 = 2 := by rw [h]
  contradiction
